title: Capabilities
lead: We coat shafts and rollers with food-grade HDPE and also print large parts in HDPE and PP, with post-milling in the same setup.

sections.heading: Food-grade HDPE coating of shafts and rollers
sections.body: We robot-print food-grade HDPE (blue), HDPE or PP directly onto your shaft or roller and mill the layer to size in the same cell. New or as a recoat of a worn roller. Suited for dough rollers in food, conveyor rollers, guide and tension rollers, or a complete plastic shaft.

specs.v: up to 3500 mm, larger on request
approx. 20 shafts per week, 3-week lead time

sections.cta: More about coating shafts and rollers

sections.heading: Robotic large-scale 3D printing
sections.body: An industrial robot arm with a granulate extruder builds parts layer by layer up to 4 × 4 × 8 metres. No bed-size limits, no welded seams in the final piece.

sections.heading: Subtractive post-milling
sections.body: The same robot switches to a milling head and finishes the printed part for clean surfaces, sharp edges, and mating faces to tolerance. No round-trip to a separate CNC machine.

specs.v: Mating faces, mounting points, decorative finish
